title: Conflict-marker check
goal: A template check that fails on tracked conflict markers
acceptance: `core/tools/check-conflict-markers.mjs` fails on a tracked line that starts with `<<<<<<< `, `=======` alone or `>>>>>>> ` outside fenced documentation examples the project marks; `npm run check:conflict-markers` and `check:fast` run it
Fixtures: clean tree, one marker, a marker inside a documented fenced example, binary files skipped
Failing test committed first: the marker fixture expects exit 1 against an empty tool; the change never edits that test to pass
privacy: Neutral content only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git. Fixtures are invented.
validation: npm run check:fast; final applicable CI
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: The report's 1 h plus fixtures written first; the nerv tool is a short port. Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed from the report's effort column. Not a measurement.
